The historical single-circle clearance relocation failed strict zero-loss gates, showing measured regressions. This bundled change (four circles, deterministic lattice, radius caps, sparse activation) may reduce disruption but remains unproven. Predicting small negative to neutral delta given the historical pattern and observed optimizer behavior rejecting the effective changes.

    return None

        return None
    dx = pivot_x - cj_x
    dy = pivot_y - cj_y
    dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    gap = dist - pivot_r - rj
    gaps.append((gap, j))

sorted_gaps = sorted(gaps)

                rj = best_params[52 + j]
                dx = cx - cj_x
                dy = cy - cj_y
                dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
                clearance = min(clearance, dist - rj)

                prev_y = new_params[2 * prev_idx + 1]

    new_params[2 * idx + 1] = best_cy
    new_params[52 + idx] = new_r
